description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rev-parse' with various parent commit options and revision expressions. It sets up test repositories, runs numerous test cases to verify command outputs, and handles expected successes and failures.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev_output
methods.description: A function that compares the output of 'git rev-parse --verify' with an expected value, executing a command and then comparing the 'expect' and 'actual' files.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Function used to commit changes in test setup.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp for internal timing.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for test purposes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, asserting correct failure behavior.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares contents of files or outputs for testing assertions.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all test cases in the script.
